items.apiTitle: OmniStream: Twitch, YouTube & Bilibili Chat Integration – Viewer Commands & Coins
items.apiDesc:
[h1]Let your stream chat play your colony[/h1]
OmniStream connects [b]Twitch, YouTube Live and Bilibili[/b] chat to RimWorld. Viewers earn coins just by chatting while they watch, then spend them with [b]!buy[/b]: food, medicine, clothes, a new colonist, a named pet, healing, revival, raids, events, or a monument with their name carved on it.

[b]100% free. No paid features. It never reads donations.[/b] Commands work in English, 繁體中文 and 简体中文.

[h2]Why streamers pick OmniStream[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Three platforms, one colony[/b]: Twitch, YouTube and Bilibili chat at the same time.
[*][b]Starts with OBS[/b]: open OBS and every signed-in platform connects. Close it and they disconnect.
[*][b]Coins for chatting, not for paying[/b]: viewers who have chatted earn coins every minute they watch. Anyone who chatted in the last 5 minutes earns a bonus. Coins carry over between streams.
[*][b]Named arrivals[/b]: colonists and animals arrive tame and already yours, under the name the viewer picked.
[*][b]Quiet chat[/b]: a failed command gets no reply and costs nothing. A successful one is answered with @name.
[*][b]You set the rules[/b]: every price, rate and rule is editable, with Default / Cheap / Expensive presets. Each price shows how long a viewer has to watch to afford it.
[*][b]YouTube quota you can see[/b]: chat is read over YouTube's official streaming connection, about 1,300 units an hour while connected, plus 20 per reply, against Google's free 10,000 a day. That is roughly 6 hours of streaming. A live quota bar shows what's left, and reading pauses on its own when it runs low.
[/list]

[h2]Coming from Twitch Toolkit or [CAP] Rimworld Interactive Chat Service?[/h2]
OmniStream is an independent mod and is not affiliated with either. If you want the same kind of viewer-command gameplay, but also on [b]YouTube and Bilibili[/b], with Chinese commands, give it a try.
[b]Use only one chat mod per channel.[/b] If two mods read the same chat, every command runs twice.

[h2]Quick start[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Open OmniStream from Options → Mod Settings, or from the [b]link[/b] button at the bottom of the screen.
[*][b]Twitch[/b]: open the Twitch token page, sign in with the live account, check chat:read and chat:edit, then paste the token into the game. You do not create an app. Leave Channel empty to listen to the account you signed in with.
[*][b]YouTube[/b]: in Google Cloud, enable YouTube Data API v3, create a Desktop OAuth client, paste the client ID and secret, then press "Sign in live channel". A reply bot account is optional. Without one, replies come from your streaming account.
[*][b]Bilibili[/b]: enter your live room number and scan the QR code.
[*]A green light and "Linked [account]" mean you're connected. To switch accounts, link again with the button next to it. Open OBS and you're live.
[/olist]
Connect joins chat now (it does nothing while OBS is closed). Disconnect pauses auto-connect until you press Connect again or restart OBS.

[h2]Viewer commands[/h2]
Start with ! or ！. The amount goes last and defaults to 1. Food, medicine, clothes and animal furniture: up to 20 at a time.
[table]
[tr][th]Command[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]!money[/td][td]Shows your coins.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!lookup keyword[/td][td]How to buy something and what it costs. Answers in the language you asked in.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!lookup animal / livestock / prized / mythic[/td][td]Animal tiers and prices.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy food / medicine amount[/td][td]Simple meals / herbal medicine.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy coat / jacket amount[/td][td]Random material and quality, cheap cloth most likely.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy animalbed / bowl / trough / litterbox amount[/td][td]Bowl, trough and litter box need a hygiene mod.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy human name[/td][td]A new colonist with your name. 1 per day across all viewers.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy livestock / prized / mythic name[/td][td]A random tamed animal from that tier that you can afford. Or name one directly, e.g. !buy cat Mochi. 1 per day across all viewers.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy heal name amount[/td][td]Treats one wound per amount, for a colonist or animal. No wound, no charge.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy comfort name amount[/td][td]A small, capped mood boost.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy revive name[/td][td]Once per name per 10 in-game days. Fresh corpses only, with side effects (both can be turned off).[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy raid / hunt[/td][td]A small raid, or 1 to 3 calm animals that briefly turn hostile.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy aurora (any event name)[/td][td]aurora, farms, herd, meeting, orbital, trader, ship, ambrosia, pod. No charge if the colony can't take it right now.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy event / !buy animal[/td][td]Typed alone, lists the most common choices with prices. The rest are on [url=https://couchinc.pages.dev/#prices]couchinc.pages.dev[/url].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]!buy monument name[/td][td]Drops in packed. Once placed it can't be repacked. Shows the name and the viewer who bought it.[/td][/tr]
[/table]
Names can't be changed later and can't match a command word or an existing name. Insects and unicorns aren't for sale.

[h2]Streamer only[/h2]
Ctrl+V opens the [b]Live[/b] window, and the next press hides it. The Live button at the bottom of the screen opens it too. Type there, then press Enter. These do nothing in chat. The window shows your commands, viewer commands, and system replies.
[list]
[*][b]!give[/b] works like !buy but costs no coins and skips the daily limits and the revive cooldown.
[*][b]!give account 500[/b] gives a viewer coins (@account, account or display name).
[*][b]!give viewer monument name[/b] carves that viewer's name on a monument.
[*][b]!ban / !unban account[/b] stops coins and commands for that viewer.
[/list]
A viewer paid you on another site? Check your phone, then paste !give yourself. OmniStream never touches Bits, Super Chats, gifts or any payment.

[h2]Coins & YouTube quota[/h2]
Coins are saved on this PC and never reset by a new day, a new stream or closing the game. You can reset everyone on the rules page. Viewers who only watch and never chat earn nothing, because chat doesn't announce who joined. A first-message bonus is given once, and defaults to 100 (change it in the settings, 0 turns it off).
The bar at the top of the settings is Google's free daily YouTube quota, with the reset time shown in your local time zone. While YouTube is connected, reading uses about 1,300 units an hour and each reply 20, and reading pauses by itself when the quota runs low.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
RimWorld 1.6. UI in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. Don't run another mod that reads the same chat (for example Twitch Toolkit or [CAP] Rimworld Interactive Chat Service on the same channel).

[hr][/hr]
[url=https://couchinc.pages.dev][img]https://couchinc.pages.dev/images/omnistream-banner-en.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Keep the colony (and two cats) fed[/h2]
OmniStream is made by one person, and the two cats supervising every line of code. It's free and always will be.
If your viewers had fun tonight, if someone just bought a thrumbo named after your cat, consider buying me a coffee or the cats a can of food. It helps me keep up with Twitch, YouTube and Bilibili API changes and new RimWorld versions.
[b][url=https://couchinc.pages.dev]couchinc.pages.dev[/url][/b]
Mainland China: [url=https://lengcn.pages.dev]lengcn.pages.dev[/url]
Can't tip? A thumbs-up, a favorite, or a mention on stream helps just as much.

[i]Keywords: Twitch integration, YouTube live chat, Bilibili danmaku, stream interaction, viewer commands, streamer mod, chat plays RimWorld.[/i]

items.apiTitle: Yellow Map Fix｜地圖變黃修復
items.apiDesc:
繼續遊戲後地圖變黃，按暫停又恢復？這個小保險絲讓地圖照常畫出來。

為什麼會變黃：遊戲每一刻先運算、再畫地圖。某個狀態每刻都在報錯時，這一幀就畫不完。

它做三件事：
- 成癮對不到需求時不再報錯（藥物模組沒開、小人需求還沒建好時最常見）。
- 健康狀態的階段超出範圍時，改用最後一階。
- 其他每刻報錯先記在日誌，地圖繼續畫。RimTalk 是最常見的觸發來源，沒有它也適用。

它是保險絲，不是根治：日誌會留下線索，方便你回報給對應的模組作者。
如果它救了你的存檔和心情，歡迎請我喝杯咖啡，或幫兩隻貓主子加點伙食費：
couchinc.pages.dev
中国大陆用户请使用国内入口：lengcn.pages.dev

---
The map turns yellow when you unpause, and pausing brings it back? This small guard keeps the map drawing.

Why: the game ticks first, then draws. An error on every tick means that frame never finishes drawing.

Three guards:
- An addiction with no matching need no longer throws (common when a drug mod is missing, or a pawn's needs are not ready).
- A health stage past the end of its list uses the last stage.
- Any other per-tick error is logged, and the map still draws. RimTalk is the usual trigger; the guard works without it.

It is a safety net, not a root-cause fix: the log keeps the clues, so you can report them to the right mod author.

Free, and tips are always optional. If it saved your colony and your mood, a coffee or a little cat food for my two cats is much appreciated:
couchinc.pages.dev
Mainland China: lengcn.pages.dev (domestic entry)

items.apiDesc:
[h1]Say goodbye to "ERR:" in your quests[/h1]
[i]Free, always. If it helps, there's a tip link at the bottom ☕[/i]

[b]Tired of seeing "ERR: [problemCauserLabel]" ruining the immersion?[/b]
It shows up most often with the vanilla Traditional Chinese translation, and it breaks the mood every time. This mod cleans it up.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
Quest titles and descriptions are sanitized in memory right before they are rendered on the UI:
[list]
[*]Removes translation errors and "ERR:" tags
[*]Removes broken variables and brackets
[*]Replaces known typos
[/list]

[h2]Safe[/h2]
It only touches text on its way to the screen. [b]Your save file is never altered.[/b]

[h2]How to use[/h2]
Subscribe, enable, restart. RimWorld 1.6.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]☕ If it restored your immersion[/h2]
This mod is free, and it will stay free. If it made your Rimworld a little cleaner, a coffee or a little extra cat food for my two cats would be wonderful, and it keeps me motivated to maintain it.
No pressure at all. A comment, a rating, or telling a friend helps just as much.

[b]👉 Tip jar: [url=https://couchinc.pages.dev]couchinc.pages.dev[/url][/b]
[b]📍 Mainland China: [url=https://lengcn.pages.dev]lengcn.pages.dev[/url][/b] (domestic entry)

[h2]I stream this game too[/h2]
I play RimWorld Extreme no-reload live on YouTube and Twitch, and chat can play along. Schedule at couchinc.pages.dev.

tchinese.title: ERR Fix: Quest Text Cleaner｜任務 ERR 亂碼修復
tchinese.html:
告別任務亂碼：自動淨化 ERR 與破損變數
完全免費。如果它幫到你，文末有投餵入口 ☕

任務面板又出現「ERR: [problemCauserLabel]」？
這是原版繁中翻譯留下來的歷史包袱，一眼看到就出戲。這個模組幫你把它清乾淨。

它怎麼做
在文字顯示到畫面之前，進行「動態攔截與清洗」：
  • 自動修復翻譯漏字
  • 抹除無效變數與破損括號
  • 取代已知的錯字
還你一個乾淨、讀起來順的任務面板。

安全
只處理要顯示在畫面上的文字，不會動到任何存檔數據。

使用方式
訂閱 → 啟用 → 重啟遊戲。適用 RimWorld 1.6。


☕ 如果它拯救了你的強迫症
這個模組完全免費，以後也是。如果它讓你的邊緣世界生活清爽了一點，歡迎請我喝杯咖啡，或幫家裡兩隻貓主子加一點伙食費，也讓我有動力繼續維護。
不捐也完全沒關係，留言、按讚、分享給朋友，就是最大的支持。

👉 投餵入口：https://couchinc.pages.dev
📍 中國大陸用戶請使用國內入口：https://lengcn.pages.dev

我也在直播
我在 YouTube 和 Twitch 直播 RimWorld 極端不讀檔，聊天室打字就能玩，歡迎來坐。班表在 couchinc.pages.dev。

  • 替换已知的错字
还你一个干净、读起来顺畅的任务面板。

安全

使用方法
